chalisa.do1: Vaiṣṇavī, who ride on Garuḍa, whose home is Mount Trikūṭa: Śakti who are Kālī, Lakṣmī and Sarasvatī, I bow to you.
chalisa.cau1: Salutations, salutations to you, Vaiṣṇo, giver of boons, auspicious and benevolent in the age of Kali. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: Your light is on the Maṇi mountain; you have taken form as the piṇḍī. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: Goddesses and gods have given you a portion of themselves; you have taken birth in Ratnākara's house. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: You performed austerities so that you might win Śrī Rāma and be called the Śakti of the Tretā age. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: Śrī Rāma said: Go to the Maṇi mountain, and be called the goddess of the Kali age. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: As Viṣṇu I will become Kalki, and in that changed form I will take you, Śakti. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: Until then, go to the Trikuṭā valley; go there and find a dark cave. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: Mother Kālī, Lakṣmī and Sarasvatī, and Mother Pārvatī, will sustain you. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Śiva are at your door; the beloved Hanumān and Bhairava keep guard. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: Ṛddhi and Siddhi wave the fly-whisk; the people of the Kali age come to worship. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: Betel leaves, areca nuts, banners and coconuts are offered, and there is the pure caraṇāmṛta, the water from your feet. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: A boon that would bear fruit was given; the Mother smiled, and came to the mountain to perform austerities. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: The flame of the Kali age blazed up, and one day she brought forth her form. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: Becoming a young girl, she came to Nagaroṭā; there the yogī Bhairava came into sight. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: Seeing her beautiful form, he was filled with desire and came running after her. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: The Mother joined the young girls, and just then the Mother went on to Kaul-Kandaulī. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: At Devā Māī she gave darśana, and the skilful Mother took the form of the wind. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: During the Navarātras she staged her play and came to the house of her devotee Śrīdhara. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: She gave a feast to the yogīs; all ate food to their liking. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: Bhairava asked for meat and wine; taking the form of the wind, she turned his wish aside. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: Shooting an arrow, she brought forth the Gaṅgā, and ran on to the mountain, carefree. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: When she came and set her feet on a rock, it was then named Caraṇa-pādukā. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: Behind her was the mighty Bhairava; she went and entered a small cave. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: She dwelt there for nine months; then she broke through the cave, went on, and spread light. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: The primal Śakti, the maiden of Brahman, the Mother came to be called Ād Kuṁvārī. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: Smiling, she reached the door of the cave; the hero Lāṅgura received her command. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: Bhairava came running; for protection, the Mother struck with her weapon. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: His head flew off and fell on the mountain-top; she went and forgave him, and granted him a boon. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: She said: I will have you worshipped along with me, and I will have the Bhairava valley made. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: First will come the sight of me, and after it, remembrance of you. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: The Mother settled there as the piṇḍī; at her feet water flows, murmuring. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: The sixty-four yoginīs and the fifty-two Bhairavas, and the seven sages, come and remember her. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: The sound of bells rings out on the mountain; the wondrous cave looks beautiful. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: The devotee Śrīdhara worshipped her, and received the boon of devotion and service. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: Your servant Dhyānū meditated on you, and came and offered a banner and a robe. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: The lion always keeps watch at the door; the lion's paw takes away sorrow. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: The great king of Jambūdvīpa won your favour and offered a golden canopy over your head. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: With it is a lovely image of diamond, and your one unbroken flame burns. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: In the Navarātras of Āśvina and Caitra may I come and have the darśana of the Piṇḍī Queen. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: Your servant Śarmā is in your refuge. Vaiṣṇo, take away our misfortune. ॥40॥
chalisa.do2: Mother, in the Kali age your glory is boundless. Dharma is in decline; may the incarnation appear.
